entities.name: RibBA
observations: A 407-aa soluble bacterial protein with fused DHBP synthase and GTP cyclohydrolase II domains.
Pfam domains: DHBP_synthase PF00926 at residues 11–201 and GTP_cyclohydro2 PF00925 at residues 212–376.
Curated homologs show 64.9–67.5% identity and 97.3–98.0% query coverage.
Predicted bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis enzyme catalyzing early steps from D-ribulose 5-phosphate and GTP.
Homolog annotations indicate Mg2+/Mn2+ binding and one Zn2+ per subunit; metal dependence is inferred for this sequence from strong homology.
Likely cytosolic enzyme involved in riboflavin/cofactor biosynthesis.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, Pfam domains, homologs, reactions, cofactors, GO and pathway annotations

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA performs the first committed transformations in the riboflavin pathway: DHBP formation from D-ribulose 5-phosphate and GTP cyclohydrolase II conversion of GTP to a pyrimidine precursor.
The pathway supplies precursors for flavin mononucleotide and flavin adenine dinucleotide cofactors.
